¿Por qué unas organizaciones sobreviven: Why do some organisations survive decades of crises, changes of management and collapsing markets, while others fall apart at the first blow? Stafford Beer, a British management theorist, asked himself that question with the tools of this block. His answer was a model: five functions that every viable system has to fulfil, that is, every system capable of maintaining its identity in a changing environment. It makes no difference whether it is a company, a hospital, a school or a living organism.
